description: He wears a muted olive-green knee-length wool tunic with long sleeves, narrow cream underlayer edges at the cuffs, and a simple dark brown leather belt with an oval metal buckle and long hanging tail. A broad rough woven olive-brown plaid wrap with fringed edges crosses the shoulders and chest, fastened near one shoulder by a round metal brooch. Brown trousers are tucked into dark brown leather boots with crisscrossed lower-leg wrapping straps. The clothing is practical and subdued, with visible textile texture and little ornamentation.
